name: Strategic Flow
description: Behavioral email architecture diagnostics for B2B SaaS. Strategic Flow diagnoses why SaaS emails get opened but not clicked, using the Decision Friction Model, a 7-point structural framework. 54 public teardowns published with an average score lift from 3.4 to 9.0 out of 10.
capabilities: Email architecture audits for SaaS product, lifecycle, and onboarding emails
Structural scoring against the 7-point Decision Friction Model
Email rebuilds with documented before/after scores
Public teardown publication and benchmark data for SaaS email patterns

tools.name: Strategic Flow Audit Tool
tools.description: Paste any email, receive a 7-point structural audit with score and rebuilt version in about 90 seconds. No signup required.

tools.name: SaaS Email Architecture Pack
tools.description: Subject Line Formula Sheet, 7 Point Audit Checklist, CTA Language Guide, 7 rebuilt templates, Teardown Masterclass. Instant download.

tools.name: Teardown Archive
tools.description: 54 public structural teardowns of SaaS emails including Semrush, HeyGen, Revolut, ElevenLabs, and Zapier, each with scored before/after rebuilds.
